_ordering_rationale: PV decroissante : 7 segments par CA FY24 (Automotive OEM #1, T&M&E, Food Equipment, Construction, Welding, Polymers&Fluids, Specialty). On regroupe les 3 plus importants en KPIs + CA total + operating margin.

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment ITW (~20% CA), expose aux auto builds globaux, pricing power demontre
kpis.description_fr: Segment Automotive OEM : composants/fixations plastiques et metal pour OEM autos. ~20% CA ITW FY24. Croissance organique liee aux auto builds.
kpis.description_en: Automotive OEM segment: plastic and metal components/fasteners for auto OEMs. ~20% ITW revenue FY24. Organic growth tied to auto builds.

kpis.signal: Segment Instron/MTS, profitabilite premium (~25%), expose au capex industriel
kpis.description_fr: Segment T&M&E : equipements de test materiaux (Instron, MTS), assemblage electronique. Marges premium, mais sensible aux cycles capex industriels.
kpis.description_en: T&M&E segment: materials testing equipment (Instron, MTS), electronic assembly. Premium margins, sensitive to industrial capex cycles.

kpis.signal: Marges les plus elevees ITW (27.2% OI margin FY24), franchise Hobart
kpis.description_fr: Segment Food Equipment : equipements commerciaux food service (Hobart). Marges operationnelles les plus elevees (~27%) parmi les 7 segments ITW.
kpis.description_en: Food Equipment segment: commercial food service equipment (Hobart). Highest operating margins (~27%) among ITW's 7 segments.

kpis.signal: Plateau sur 3 ans (15.9-16.1Mds$), croissance organique difficile, capital allocation prime
kpis.description_fr: CA total ITW = somme des 7 segments. Plateau autour de 15.9-16.1Mds$ depuis FY22. Croissance organique limitee, focus capital allocation (buybacks $1.5Mds FY24).
kpis.description_en: Total ITW revenue = sum of 7 segments. Plateau around $15.9-16.1B since FY22. Limited organic growth, capital allocation focus (buybacks $1.5B FY24).

kpis.signal: Marge record 26.8% (+170bps YoY, dont 70bps LIFO->FIFO), ITW Business Model en action
kpis.description_fr: Marge operationnelle FY24 record a 26.8% (4264M$/15898M$). +170bps YoY dont +70bps de l'impact LIFO->FIFO accounting change, +100bps initiatives ITW Business Model.
kpis.description_en: FY24 record operating margin 26.8% ($4264M/$15898M). +170bps YoY of which +70bps from LIFO->FIFO accounting change, +100bps from ITW Business Model initiatives.

_notes: Historique 5 ans FY20-FY24 pour les 3 segments principaux + Total. Operating margin FY20=2882/12574=22.9%, FY21=3477/14455=24.0%, FY22=3790/15932=23.8%, FY23=4040/16107=25.1%, FY24=4264/15898=26.8%. Sources : 10-K SEC Illinois Tool Works tableaux Operating Revenue/Income par segment.
